title: Everything You Need to Know About DIRECTV’s MyEntertainment Genre Pack
summary: DIRECTV has a slew of packs to check out, but here’s why the MyEntertainment Pack is at the top of our list.
contentText:

get directv'S MYENTERTAINMENT GENRE PACK HERE

Even better news, new customers can take advantage of a five-day free trial so you can test out the package before committing 2 . (Access to HBO Max content begins after trial.)

In short, this genre package is made for those who want to focus on saving money on streaming while getting the best bang for their buck. Some of our favorite music-oriented movies and shows are available through this genre pack, including Dance Moms , the Love & Hip Hop franchise, Pose , The School of Rock , Grease and The Sound of Music and Soundtracks: Songs That Defined History.

Just to reiterate, this genre pack is different from DIRECTV’s streaming packages because it focuses primarily on a specific genre of channels all in one place, hence the name. In general, this package, along with the other genre packs, is less expensive than the streaming packages. These genre packs also include fewer channels than the streaming packages, since the streaming packages are meant to replicate the wide breadth of channels you’d get with cable. 

The MyEntertainment genre pack is a ShopBillboard favorite, especially if you’re looking to tune in to music-oriented shows and films. If you’re seeking out something different, DIRECTV also offers a MySports genre pack for sports lovers, a MyKids genre pack to keep your little ones entertained and even a MyNews pack for those looking to keep informed.

For more information on Genre Packs, go to directv.com/affiliates/genre-packs .
